title: Great app
body: I especially like the widget where is possible to mark the status of the particular activity. I found such functionality rare. The app and the widget as well divides the activities in the day times like morning, afternoon, evening and night what is great as well. One small thing that I'd add would be the possibility to move the added activities in the daytime list up and down to get exact desired time sequence. Now the last added activity gets on the first line in the list and you can't move it.
author: PetrVojt
